SMALL CLAIMS HEARING OF APR-26-2011 - JUDGMENT. APPEARANCE BY PLAINTIFF ONLY. JUDGE: DONALD MITCHELL. CLERK: S. VANTREE. NOT REPORTED. (506)

MINI-MINUTES FOR JUN-17-2011 1:30 PM FOR DEPT 506
SMALL CLAIMS CALENDAR OF JUL-15-2011 - TAKEN UNDER SUBMISSION AS OF JUL-15-2011 BY DONALD S. MITCHELL. APPEARANCE BY PLAINTIFF AND DEFENDANT. CLERK: S. VANTREE. NOT REPORTED. (506)
